name: Prefa
summary: Russian 3-player trick-taking bidding game with 32-card deck where soloist bids tricks and trump against two defenders.
rules_text: Played with 32-card Piquet deck, Aces high, tens between Jack and Nine. 3 active players (4th sits out as dealer). Deal 10 cards each in 2s and 2 cards as talon. Elder hand starts bidding. Bids are number of tricks 6-10 plus suit ranking Spades<Clubs<Diamonds<Hearts<NoTrump, with Misere between 8NT and 9S. Must raise, except opener may match. Three passes ends bidding or leads to all-pass misere game. Highest bidder shows talon, takes it, discards 2 face down, declares contract at least as high as winning bid. Defenders in order say whist or pass. If no whist, declarer wins contract automatically. If one whists, may play open with both defender hands. Trick play: must follow suit, must trump if void. Highest trump or led suit wins. Declarer must make contract, otherwise penalized. Defenders must jointly make 4 tricks vs 6, 2 vs 7, 1 vs 8+ or whisters penalized.
rating_reason: 3-4p bidding trick game, sophisticated variant, strategic
